The '''Blast vest''', also called '''semi-armor''' or '''protective vest''', was a type of light [[Armor/Legends|armor]] which protected a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid's]] torso. Despite the name, they provided only minimal protection from [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts and other energy attacks. However, they effectively protected the torso from physical attacks such as shrapnel from explosive [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] or bullets from [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]]. Blast vests left the [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] unprotected, but therefore did not hinder the user's mobility.<ref name="Second Edition">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', Second Edition]]</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], protective vests came in a variety of types, with varying levels of coverage and protection. Some covered only the front part of the torso<ref name="Second Edition" /> while others covered both front and back.<ref name="Revised and Expanded">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> The [[Mk 45 Protective Vest]] was one popular model.<ref name="GG10">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref> Prices for a blast vest during the Galactic Civil War ranged from about 300 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for a simple vest<ref name="Second Edition" /> to 500 credits for a blast vest which came with a matching [[Blast helmet/Legends|blast helmet]].<ref name="Star Wars Roleplaying Game">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>
